focus.title: A servant heart
focus.ask: Whose load could you make lighter this week?
focus.act: Do one quiet act of service that nobody will thank you for.

focus.title: Time with God
focus.ask: When and where do you pray alone? What gets in the way?
focus.act: Set a fixed 10 minutes a day this week for prayer, and keep it.

focus.title: Integrity
focus.ask: Where is the gap between what you say and what you do?
focus.act: Finish one thing you promised, and tell the truth where it is uncomfortable.

focus.title: Listening first
focus.ask: Who needs you to listen more than talk?
focus.act: In your next conversation, ask one more question before you give advice.

focus.title: Encouragement
focus.ask: Who on your team has not been thanked lately?
focus.act: Send two short messages of thanks to people who serve with you.

focus.title: Humility
focus.ask: Where do you need to put someone else’s need before your own?
focus.act: Let someone else take the credit for something this week.

focus.title: Vision
focus.ask: What is God asking your ministry to become in a year?
focus.act: Write one sentence about where your team is going and share it with them.

focus.title: Teamwork
focus.ask: Who is working alone who needs a partner?
focus.act: Invite someone to serve beside you in one task.

focus.title: Courage
focus.ask: What have you been avoiding because you are afraid?
focus.act: Take one small step toward it, and pray before you do.

focus.title: Forgiveness
focus.ask: Is there anyone you need to forgive, or ask to forgive you?
focus.act: Make the first move toward peace with one person.

focus.title: Faithfulness
focus.ask: What small thing has God trusted you with?
focus.act: Do your assigned task early and well this week.

focus.title: Wisdom
focus.ask: What decision are you facing that needs God’s wisdom?
focus.act: Ask God for wisdom about it each morning, then talk with a wise person.
